margin: 0; padding: 0; }<br><br>html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }<br><br>body {<br>  font-family: var(--font-body);<br>  font-size: 16px;<br>  line-height: 1.7;<br>  color: var(--ink);<br>  background-color: var(--cream);<br>  background-image:<br>    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(200,146,42,.07) 0%, transparent 60%),<br>    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 90%, rgba(179,74,42,.06) 0%, transparent 60%);<br>  min-height: 100vh;<br>  display: flex;<br>  flex-direction: column;<br>}<br><br>a { color: var(--rust); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--transition); }<br>a:hover { color: var(--rust-light); }<br><br>/* ── Header ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.site-header {<br>  background: var(--ink);<br>  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--rust);<br>  position: sticky;<br>  top: 0;<br>  z-index: 100;<br>}<br><br>.header-inner {<br>  max-width: 1100px;<br>  margin: 0 auto;<br>  padding: 0 2rem;<br>  height: 64px;<br>  display: flex;<br>  align-items: center;<br>  justify-content: space-between;<br>}<br><br>.brand {<br>  display: flex;<br>  align-items: center;<br>  gap: .5rem;<br>  color: var(--cream) !important;<br>  font-family: var(--font-display);<br>  font-size: 1.35rem;<br>  font-weight: 700;<br>  letter-spacing: .02em;<br>}<br>.brand-icon { font-size: 1.4rem; }<br>.brand:hover { color: var(--gold) !important; }<br><br>.site-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; }<br><br>.nav-link {<br>  color: rgba(245,240,232,.7);<br>  font-size: .9rem;<br>  letter-spacing: .04em;<br>  text-transform: uppercase;<br>  transition: color var(--transition);<br>}<br>.nav-link:hover,<br>.nav-link.active { color: var(--cream); }<br><br>.nav-cta {<br>  background: var(--rust);<br>  color: var(--cream) !important;<br>  padding: .45rem 1.1rem;<br>  border-radius: 100px;<br>  font-size: .85rem;<br>  letter-spacing: .04em;<br>  text-transform: uppercase;<br>  font-weight: 500;<br>  transition: background var(--transition), transform var(--transition);<br>}<br>.nav-cta:hover { background: var(--rust-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }<br><br>/* ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.site-main { flex: 1; }<br><br>/* ── Flash messages ─────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.flash-container { max-width: 1100px; margin: 1.5rem auto 0; padding: 0 2rem; }<br><br>.flash {<br>  padding: .85rem 1.2rem;<br>  border-radius: var(--radius);<br>  border-left: 4px solid;<br>  font-size: .9rem;<br>  margin-bottom: .75rem;<br>}<br>.flash--success { background: var(--sage-pale); border-color: var(--sage); color: var(--sage); }<br>.flash--error   { background: var(--rust-pale); border-color: var(--rust); color: var(--rust); }<br>.flash--info    { background: var(--gold-pale); border-color: var(--gold); color: #7a5510; }<br><br>/* ── Hero ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.page-hero {<br>  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);<br>  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--cream), var(--cream-dark));<br>  padding: 3.5rem 2rem 2.5rem;<br>}<br><br>.hero-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }<br><br>.hero-title {<br>  font-family: var(--font-display);<br>  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.2rem);<br>  font-weight: 700;<br>  line-height: 1.15;<br>  color: var(--ink);<br>}<br><br>.hero-title::after {<br>  content: '';<br>  display: block;<br>  width: 60px;<br>  height: 3px;<br>  background: var(--rust);<br>  margin-top: .6rem;<br>  border-radius: 2px;<br>}<br><br>.hero-sub {<br>  font-size: .95rem;<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  margin-top: .5rem;<br>  font-style: italic;<br>}<br><br>/* ── Controls bar ───────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.controls-bar {<br>  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);<br>  background: var(--cream);<br>  padding: 1rem 2rem;<br>  position: sticky;<br>  top: 64px;<br>  z-index: 90;<br>  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);<br>}<br><br>.controls-inner {<br>  max-width: 1100px;<br>  margin: 0 auto;<br>  display: flex;<br>  align-items: center;<br>  gap: 1.5rem;<br>  flex-wrap: wrap;<br>}<br><br>.search-wrap {<br>  flex: 1;<br>  min-width: 200px;<br>  position: relative;<br>  display: flex;<br>  align-items: center;<br>}<br><br>.search-icon {<br>  position: absolute;<br>  left: .9rem;<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  font-size: 1rem;<br>  pointer-events: none;<br>}<br><br>.search-input {<br>  width: 100%;<br>  padding: .6rem 2.4rem .6rem 2.4rem;<br>  border: 1.5px solid var(--border);<br>  border-radius: 100px;<br>  background: white;<br>  font-family: var(--font-body);<br>  font-size: .9rem;<br>  color: var(--ink);<br>  transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);<br>}<br>.search-input:focus {<br>  outline: none;<br>  border-color: var(--rust);<br>  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(179,74,42,.12);<br>}<br>.search-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-light); }<br><br>.search-clear {<br>  position: absolute;<br>  right: .75rem;<br>  background: none;<br>  border: none;<br>  cursor: pointer;<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  font-size: 1.1rem;<br>  line-height: 1;<br>  padding: .1rem .3rem;<br>  border-radius: 50%;<br>  transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition);<br>}<br>.search-clear:hover { color: var(--rust); background: var(--rust-pale); }<br><br>.filter-label {<br>  font-size: .8rem;<br>  letter-spacing: .05em;<br>  text-transform: uppercase;<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  white-space: nowrap;<br>}<br><br>.filter-wrap, .sort-wrap {<br>  display: flex;<br>  align-items: center;<br>  gap: .5rem;<br>}<br><br>.filter-select {<br>  padding: .5rem .85rem;<br>  border: 1.5px solid var(--border);<br>  border-radius: 6px;<br>  background: white;<br>  font-family: var(--font-body);<br>  font-size: .875rem;<br>  color: var(--ink);<br>  cursor: pointer;<br>  transition: border-color var(--transition);<br>}<br>.filter-select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--rust); }<br><br>/* ── Book grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.book-section {<br>  max-width: 1100px;<br>  margin: 2rem auto;<br>  padding: 0 2rem 4rem;<br>}<br><br>.book-grid {<br>  display: grid;<br>  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));<br>  gap: 1.5rem;<br>}<br><br>/* ── Book card ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.book-card {<br>  background: white;<br>  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);<br>  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);<br>  border: 1px solid var(--border);<br>  display: flex;<br>  overflow: hidden;<br>  transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);<br>  animation: cardIn .3s ease both;<br>}<br><br>@keyframes cardIn {<br>  from { opacity: 0; }<br><br>.book-spine {<br>  width: 8px;<br>  background: var(--rust);<br>  flex-shrink: 0;<br>  border-radius: var(--radius-lg) 0 0 var(--radius-lg);<br>  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rust) 0%, var(--gold) 100%);<br>}<br><br>.book-body {<br>  padding: 1.2rem 1.2rem 1rem;<br>  flex: 1;<br>  display: flex;<br>  flex-direction: column;<br>  gap: .3rem;<br>}<br><br>.book-meta-top {<br>  display: flex;<br>  justify-content: space-between;<br>  align-items: center;<br>  margin-bottom: .3rem;<br>}<br><br>.book-year {<br>  font-size: .8rem;<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  font-style: italic;<br>}<br><br>.book-rating {<br>  display: flex;<br>  align-items: center;<br>  gap: .25rem;<br>  font-size: .8rem;<br>  color: var(--gold);<br>}<br><br>.book-rating--none {<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  font-size: .78rem;<br>  font-style: italic;<br>}<br><br>/* Star rating display */<br>.star-fill {<br>  display: inline-block;<br>  position: relative;<br>  color: var(--cream-dark);<br>  letter-spacing: 1px;<br>}<br>.star-fill::before {<br>  content: '★★★★★';<br>  position: absolute;<br>  left: 0;<br>  top: 0;<br>  color: var(--gold);<br>  width: var(--pct);<br>  overflow: hidden;<br>  white-space: nowrap;<br>}<br><br>.rating-val {<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  font-size: .78rem;<br>}<br><br>.book-title {<br>  font-family: var(--font-display);<br>  font-size: 1.05rem;<br>  font-weight: 700;<br>  line-height: 1.3;<br>  color: var(--ink);<br>}<br><br>.book-author {<br>  font-size: .875rem;<br>  color: var(--ink-light);<br>  font-style: italic;<br>}<br><br>.book-actions {<br>  display: flex;<br>  gap: .5rem;<br>  margin-top: auto;<br>  padding-top: .8rem;<br>}<br><br>.inline-form { display: inline; }<br><br>/* ── Buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */<br>.btn {<br>  display: inline-flex;<br>  align-items: center;<br>  justify-content: center;<br>  gap: .4rem;<br>  padding: .55rem 1.2rem;<br>  border-radius: 6px;<br>  font-family: var(--font-body);<br>  font-size: .875rem;<br>  font-weight: 500;<br>  cursor: pointer;<br>  border: 1.5px solid transparent;<br>  transition: all var(--transition);<br>  text-decoration: none;<br>  white-space: nowrap;<br>}<br><br>.btn--primary {<br>  background: var(--rust);<br>  color: white;<br>  border-color: var(--rust);<br>}<br>.btn--primary:hover {<br>  background: var(--rust-light);<br>  border-color: var(--rust-light);<br>  color: white;<br>  transform: translateY(-1px);<br>}<br><br>.btn--ghost {<br>  background: transparent;<br>  color: var(--ink-mid);<br>  border-color: var(--border);<br>}<br>.btn--ghost:hover {<br>  background: var(--cream-dark);<br>  color: var(--ink);<br>  border-color: rgba(26,22,18,.2);<br>}<br><br>.btn--danger {<br>  background: transparent;<br>  color: var(--rust);<br>  border-color: rgba(179,74,42,.3);<br>}<br>.btn--danger:hover {<br>  background: var(--rust-pale);<br>  border-color: var(--rust);<br>}<br><br>.btn--sm { padding: .35rem .85rem; // no books at all \u2014 static empty state shown by server\n\n  function getCards() {\n    return Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.book-card'));\n  }\n\n  function applyFilters() {\n    var query     = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();\n    var minRating = parseFloat(ratingFilter.value) \|\| 0;\n    var sortKey   = sortSelect.value;\n\n    // Show / hide clear button\n    searchClear.hidden = query.length === 0;\n\n    var cards = getCards();\n    var visible = [];\n\n    cards.forEach(function (card) {\n      var title  = card.dataset.title  \|\| '';\n      var author = card.dataset.author \|\| '';\n      var rating = parseFloat(card.dataset.rating) \|\| 0;\n\n      var matchesQuery  = !query \|\| title.includes(query) \|\| author.includes(query);\n      var matchesRating = rating >= minRating;\n\n      if (matchesQuery && matchesRating) {\n        card.classList.remove('hidden');\n        visible.push(card);\n      } else {\n        card.classList.add('hidden');\n      }\n    });\n\n    // Sort visible cards\n    visible.sort(function (a, b) {\n      if (sortKey === 'title')  return a.dataset.title.localeCompare(b.dataset.title);\n      if (sortKey === 'author') return a.dataset.author.localeCompare(b.dataset.author);\n      if (sortKey === 'year')   return parseInt(b.dataset.year)   - parseInt(a.dataset.year);\n      if (sortKey === 'rating') return parseFloat(b.dataset.rating) - parseFloat(a.dataset.rating);\n      return 0;\n    });\n\n    // Re-append in sorted order (hidden ones stay where they are, invisible)\n    visible.forEach(function (card) { grid.appendChild(card); });\n\n    // Toggle empty state\n    if (emptyState) {\n      emptyState.hidden = visible.length > 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Debounce helper \u2014 avoids firing on every keystroke\n  function debounce(fn, ms) {\n    var timer;\n    return function () {\n      clearTimeout(timer);\n      timer = setTimeout(fn, ms);\n    };\n  }\n\n  searchInput.addEventListener('input',  debounce(applyFilters, 180));\n  ratingFilter.addEventListener('change', applyFilters);\n  sortSelect.addEventListener('change',   applyFilters);\n\n  searchClear.addEventListener('click', function () {\n    searchInput.value = '';\n    searchClear.hidden = true;\n    applyFilters();\n    searchInput.focus();\n  });\n\n  // Expose for inline onclick in template\n  window.clearSearch = function () {\n    searchInput.value = '';\n    ratingFilter.value = '0';\n    sortSelect.value = 'title';\n    applyFilters();\n  };\n\n  // Run once on load to apply default sort\n  applyFilters();\n}());\n", "filename": "/mnt/user-data/outputs/static/js/list.js"} |

}\n\n  function clearState(id) {\n    var field = fieldEl(id);\n    var fb    = feedbackEl(id);\n    field.classList.remove('is-valid', 'is-invalid');\n    fb.textContent = '';\n  }\n\n  // \u2500\u2500 Validators else clearState('year');\n  });\n  yearInput.addEventListener('blur', validateYear);\n\n  ratingInput.addEventListener('input', validateRating);\n  ratingInput.addEventListener('blur', var ok = validateTitle() & validateAuthor() & validateYear() & validateRating();\n    // using & (not &&) so ALL validators run and all errors are shown at once\n    if (!ok) {\n firstInvalid.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Prevent double-submit\n    submitBtn.disabled = true;\n    submitBtn.textContent = | text |  Good call — steps 9 and 10 together before touching the DB. I'll build a self-contained `routes_memory.py` that plugs straight into the existing app structure.<br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br>Now update `form.html` to handle the `prefill` dict that `routes_memory.py` passes back when validation fails — so the user doesn't lose what they typed:<br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br>Also need to default `prefill` in `base.html`-less contexts — the safest fix is a default in the template itself:<br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br>Here's what was built and why each decision was made:<br><br>**`routes_memory.py`** is a completely standalone Flask app — it imports nothing from `app.py` and can run on its own. This keeps the in-memory experiment clean so it doesn't pollute the DB-backed code.<br><br>**The `BOOKS` list and `_next_id` counter** act as a dead-simple stand-in for the database. Each book is a plain dict with the same four fields as your schema (`title`, `author`, `year`, `rating`). Three seed books are included so the list page isn't empty on first run.<br><br>**`parse_book_form()`** is extracted into its own helper rather than duplicated inside `add_book` and `edit_book`. It handles all four fields, type-coerces `year` to `int` and `rating` to `float`, and returns either a clean data dict or a list of error messages. Both routes call it the same way.<br><br>**Validation failure re-renders the form** with the `prefill` dict passed back in — so the user doesn't lose what they typed. That's what the `form.html` update handles: for each field, it now checks `prefill` first, then falls back to the saved `book` value, then to an empty string.<br><br>**`delete_book` uses POST**, not GET — same as `app.py`. A GET-based delete would mean anyone who links to or prefetches the URL could accidentally wipe a record.<br><br>**Switching between the two files** is one command:<br>```bash<br># In-memory (steps 9 & 10)<br>FLASK_APP=routes_memory.py flask run<br><br># DB-backed (step 5 onwards)<br>FLASK_APP=app.py flask run<br>```<br>Both share the same templates and static files — nothing else changes. |

| 24 |  |  |  | [] |  |  |  | null |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | 2026-06-09T14:17:08.880032Z | 2026-06-09T14:17:18.816097Z |  | Here's what was built and why each decision was made:<br><br>**`routes_memory.py`** is a completely standalone Flask app — it imports nothing from `app.py` and can run on its own. This keeps the in-memory experiment clean so it doesn't pollute the DB-backed code.<br><br>**The `BOOKS` list and `_next_id` counter** act as a dead-simple stand-in for the database. Each book is a plain dict with the same four fields as your schema (`title`, `author`, `year`, `rating`). Three seed books are included so the list page isn't empty on first run.<br><br>**`parse_book_form()`** is extracted into its own helper rather than duplicated inside `add_book` and `edit_book`. It handles all four fields, type-coerces `year` to `int` and `rating` to `float`, and returns either a clean data dict or a list of error messages. Both routes call it the same way.<br><br>**Validation failure re-renders the form** with the `prefill` dict passed back in — so the user doesn't lose what they typed. That's what the `form.html` update handles: for each field, it now checks `prefill` first, then falls back to the saved `book` value, then to an empty string.<br><br>**`delete_book` uses POST**, not GET — same as `app.py`. A GET-based delete would mean anyone who links to or prefetches the URL could accidentally wipe a record.<br><br>**Switching between the two files** is one command:<br>```bash<br># In-memory (steps 9 & 10)<br>FLASK_APP=routes_memory.py flask run<br><br># DB-backed (step 5 onwards)<br>FLASK_APP=app.py flask run<br>```<br>Both share the same templates and static files — nothing else changes. |  | text |

| json_block | {"language": "python", "code": "\"\"\"\nroutes_memory.py  \u2014  Steps 9 & 10\nFlask routes wired to an in-memory list instead of PostgreSQL.\nSwap this out for the DB-backed routes in app.py once the schema is ready.\n\nUsage:\n    FLASK_APP=routes_memory.py flask run\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nfrom flask import (\n    Flask, render_template, request,\n    redirect, url_for, flash\n)\nfrom dotenv import load_dotenv\n\nload_dotenv()\n\napp = Flask(__name__)\napp.secret_key = os.environ.get(\"SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-secret-change-me\")\n\n# \u2500\u2500 In-memory store \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n# Mirrors the books table: id, title, author, year, rating (float \| None)\n# This list lives only for the lifetime of the Flask process.\n\n_next_id = 1          # auto-increment counter\n\nBOOKS = [             # a few seed entries so the list page isn't empty\n    {\"id\": 1, \"title\": \"The Name of the Wind\",   \"author\": \"Patrick Rothfuss\", \"year\": 2007, \"rating\": 4.5},\n    {\"id\": 2, \"title\": \"Sapiens\",                \"author\": \"Yuval Noah Harari\", \"year\": 2011, \"rating\": 4.2},\n    {\"id\": 3, \"title\": \"The Hitchhiker's Guide\", \"author\": \"Douglas Adams\",     \"year\": 1979, \"rating\": 4.8},\n]\n_next_id = len(BOOKS) + 1\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Helpers \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef find_book(book_id):\n    \"\"\"Return the book dict with the given id, or None.\"\"\"\n    return next((b for b in BOOKS if b[\"id\"] == book_id), None)\n\n\ndef parse_book_form(form):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract and validate form fields.\n    Returns (data_dict, errors_list).\n    data_dict is None if there are errors.\n    \"\"\"\n    title  = form.get(\"title\",  \"\").strip()\n    author = form.get(\"author\", \"\").strip()\n    year   = form.get(\"year\",   \"\").strip()\n    rating = form.get(\"rating\", \"\").strip() or None\n\n    errors = []\n\n    if not title:\n        errors.append(\"Title is required.\")\n    if not author:\n        errors.append(\"Author is required.\")\n\n    if not year:\n        errors.append(\"Publication year is required.\")\n        year = None\n    else:\n        try:\n            year = int(year)\n            if year < 1 or year > 2100:\n                raise ValueError\n        except ValueError:\n            errors.append(\"Year must be a number between 1 and 2100.\")\n            year = None\n\n    if rating is not None:\n        try:\n            rating = round(float(rating), 1)\n            if not (0.0 <= rating <= 5.0):\n                raise ValueError\n        except ValueError:\n            errors.append(\"Rating must be a number between 0.0 and 5.0.\")\n            rating = None\n\n    if errors:\n        return None, errors\n\n    return {\"title\": title, \"author\": author, \"year\": year, \"rating\": rating}, []\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Routes \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n# LIST  GET /\n@app.route(\"/\")\ndef index():\n    \"\"\"Show every book in the in-memory list.\"\"\"\n    return render_template(\"index.html\", books=BOOKS)\n\n\n# ADD   GET  /books/add   \u2192 show blank form\n#       POST /books/add   \u2192 create book, redirect to list\n@app.route(\"/books/add\", methods=[\"GET\", \"POST\"])\ndef add_book():\n    global _next_id\n\n    if request.method == \"POST\":\n        data, errors = parse_book_form(request.form)\n\n        if errors:\n            for err in errors:\n                flash(err, \"error\")\n            # Re-render the form with the values the user typed so far\n            return render_template(\"form.html\", book=None,\n                                   prefill=request.form)\n\n        new_book = {\"id\": _next_id, **data}\n        BOOKS.append(new_book)\n        _next_id += 1\n\n        flash(f'\"{data[\"title\"]}\" added to your shelf.', \"success\")\n        return redirect(url_for(\"index\"))\n\n    return render_template(\"form.html\", book=None, prefill={})\n\n\n# EDIT  GET  /books/<id>/edit  \u2192 show form pre-filled with existing data\n#       POST /books/<id>/edit  \u2192 update book, redirect to list\n@app.route(\"/books/<int:book_id>/edit\", methods=[\"GET\", \"POST\"])\ndef edit_book(book_id):\n    book = find_book(book_id)\n\n    if book is None:\n        flash(\"Book not found.\", \"error\")\n        return redirect(url_for(\"index\"))\n\n    if request.method == \"POST\":\n        data, errors = parse_book_form(request.form)\n\n        if errors:\n            for err in errors:\n                flash(err, \"error\")\n            return render_template(\"form.html\", book=book,\n                                   prefill=request.form)\n\n        # Update the dict in-place so the list reflects the change\n        book.update(data)\n\n        flash(f'\"{data[\"title\"]}\" updated.', \"success\")\n        return redirect(url_for(\"index\"))\n\n    return render_template(\"form.html\", book=book, prefill={})\n\n\n# DELETE  POST /books/<id>/delete  \u2192 remove book, redirect to list\n# (POST not GET \u2014 deletes should never happen via a plain link)\n@app.route(\"/books/<int:book_id>/delete\", methods=[\"POST\"])\ndef delete_book(book_id):\n    global BOOKS\n    book = find_book(book_id)\n\n    if book is None:\n        flash(\"Book not found.\", \"error\")\n    else:\n        BOOKS = [b for b in BOOKS if b[\"id\"] != book_id]\n        flash(f'\"{book[\"title\"]}\" removed from your shelf.', \"success\")\n\n    return redirect(url_for(\"index\"))\n\n\n# HEALTH  GET /health\n@app.route(\"/health\")\ndef health():\n    return {\"status\": \"ok\", \"store\": \"memory\", \"books\": len(BOOKS)}, 200\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Dev entry point The `books` table gets a `user_id` column that's a foreign key back to `users`, with `ON DELETE CASCADE` so removing a user wipes their books too. An index on `books(user_id)` keeps the per-user list query fast.<br><br>---<br><br>**`app.py` — four additions**<br><br>`bcrypt` is imported and used for hashing on signup and checking on login. A `login_required` decorator wraps every book route — it checks `session["user_id"]` and redirects to `/login` if missing. Every DB query on books now includes `AND user_id = current_user_id()` so users can never see or modify each other's data. Three new routes handle `/signup`, `/login`, and `/logout` (logout is POST-only to prevent accidental logouts from link prefetching). The login route uses a dummy hash check even when the username doesn't exist, to prevent timing attacks that reveal which usernames are registered.<br><br>---<br><br>**`base.html` — nav is now auth-aware**<br><br>When `session.user_id` is set, the nav shows Library, + Add Book, the username in italics, and a Log out button. When no session exists, it shows Log in and Sign up instead. The logout button is a `<form method="POST">` because logouts that change state should never be GET requests.<br><br>---<br><br>**`login.html` + `signup.html` — two new templates**<br><br>Both share the same centred card layout. The signup form has a live password strength bar (four levels: Weak → Strong), a confirm password field with match checking, and a username character-class check. The login form is intentionally minimal. Both have show/hide toggles on password fields.<br><br>---<br><br>**`style.css` — appended auth section**<br><br>Adds `.auth-page`, `.auth-wrap`, strength bar, `.nav-user`, `.btn-logout`, and `.toggle-pw`. Nothing existing was touched.<br><br>---<br><br>**`auth.js` — new file**<br><br>Handles both forms from a single file (it checks which form is present). Validates username format, password length, confirm match, and strength score on every keystroke and on blur — all errors shown at once on submit. Show/hide toggles are wired to any `.toggle-pw` button.<br><br>---<br><br>**`index.html` — one line changed**<br><br>Hero title now reads `{{ session.username }}'s Library` instead of `Your Library`.<br><br>---<br><br>**Install bcrypt before running:**<br>```bash<br>pip install bcrypt<br>``` |

The `books` table gets a `user_id` column that's a foreign key back to `users`, with `ON DELETE CASCADE` so removing a user wipes their books too. An index on `books(user_id)` keeps the per-user list query fast.<br><br>---<br><br>**`app.py` — four additions**<br><br>`bcrypt` is imported and used for hashing on signup and checking on login. A `login_required` decorator wraps every book route — it checks `session["user_id"]` and redirects to `/login` if missing. Every DB query on books now includes `AND user_id = current_user_id()` so users can never see or modify each other's data. Three new routes handle `/signup`, `/login`, and `/logout` (logout is POST-only to prevent accidental logouts from link prefetching). The login route uses a dummy hash check even when the username doesn't exist, to prevent timing attacks that reveal which usernames are registered.<br><br>---<br><br>**`base.html` — nav is now auth-aware**<br><br>When `session.user_id` is set, the nav shows Library, + Add Book, the username in italics, and a Log out button. When no session exists, it shows Log in and Sign up instead. The logout button is a `<form method="POST">` because logouts that change state should never be GET requests.<br><br>---<br><br>**`login.html` + `signup.html` — two new templates**<br><br>Both share the same centred card layout. The signup form has a live password strength bar (four levels: Weak → Strong), a confirm password field with match checking, and a username character-class check. The login form is intentionally minimal. Both have show/hide toggles on password fields.<br><br>---<br><br>**`style.css` — appended auth section**<br><br>Adds `.auth-page`, `.auth-wrap`, strength bar, `.nav-user`, `.btn-logout`, and `.toggle-pw`. Nothing existing was touched.<br><br>---<br><br>**`auth.js` — new file**<br><br>Handles both forms from a single file (it checks which form is present). Validates username format, password length, confirm match, and strength score on every keystroke and on blur — all errors shown at once on submit. Show/hide toggles are wired to any `.toggle-pw` button.<br><br>---<br><br>**`index.html` — one line changed**<br><br>Hero title now reads `{{ session.username }}'s Library` instead of `Your Library`.<br><br>---<br><br>**Install bcrypt before running:**<br>```bash<br>pip install bcrypt<br>``` |  | text |

\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nDROP \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nCREATE TABLE users (\n    id            SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n    username      VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,           -- bcrypt hash\n    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- \u2500\u2500 Books (each row belongs to one user) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nCREATE TABLE books (\n    id        SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id   INTEGER      NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    title     VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    author    VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    year      INTEGER      NOT NULL,\n    rating    NUMERIC(3,1) CHECK (rating >= 0.0 AND rating <= 5.0),\n    added_at  TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()\n);\n\n-- Index so \"SELECT * FROM flash(\"Please log in to access your shelf.\", \"info\")\n            return redirect(url_for(\"login\"))\n        return f(*args, **kwargs)\n    return decorated\n\n\ndef current_user_id():\n    return session.get(\"user_id\")\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500 Validation helper \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef form.get(\"author\", \"\").strip()\n    year   = form.get(\"year\",   \"\").strip()\n    rating = form.get(\"rating\", \"\").strip() or None\n\n    errors = []\n    if not title:  errors.append(\"Title is required.\")\n    if not author: errors.append(\"Author is required.\")\n\n    if not year:\n        errors.append(\"Publication year is required.\")\n        year = None\n    else:\n        try:\n            year = int(year)\n            if year < 1 or year > 2100:\n                raise ValueError\n        except ValueError:\n            errors.append(\"Year must be a whole number between 1 and 2100.\")\n            year = None\n\n    if rating is not None:\n        try:\n            rating = round(float(rating), 1)\n            if not (0.0 <= rating <= 5.0):\n | json_block | {"language": "bash", "code": "cat >> /mnt/user-data/outputs/static/css/style.css << 'EOF'\n\n\n/* \u2500\u2500 Auth pages (login / signup) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500 */\n.auth-page {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: center;\n  align-items: flex-start;\n  padding: 4rem 1.5rem 6rem;\n  min-height: calc(100vh - 64px - 56px);\n}\n\n.auth-wrap {\n  background: white;\n  border: 1px solid var(--border);\n  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);\n  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);\n  padding: 2.5rem 2.5rem 2rem;\n  width: 100%;\n  max-width: 420px;\n}\n\n.auth-brand {\n  text-align: center;\n  margin-bottom: 2rem;\n}\n\n.auth-icon {\n  font-size: 2.4rem;\n  display: block;\n  margin-bottom: .5rem;\n}\n\n.auth-title {\n  font-family: var(--font-display);\n  font-size: 1.7rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  line-height: 1.2;\n}\n\n.auth-sub {\n  font-size: .9rem;\n  color: var(--ink-light);\n  font-style: italic;\n  margin-top: .3rem;\n}\n\n.auth-switch {\n  text-align: center;\n  font-size: .875rem;\n  color: var(--ink-light);\n  margin-top: 1.25rem;\n}\n.auth-switch a { color: var(--rust); font-weight: 500; }\n.auth-switch a:hover { color: var(--rust-light); }\n\n/* Full-width button variant */\n.btn--full { width: 100%; justify-content: center; margin-top: .5rem; }\n\n/* Show / hide password toggle */\n.toggle-pw {\n  float: right;\n  background: none;\n  border: none;\n  font-family: var(--font-body);\n  font-size: .75rem;\n  color: var(--rust);\n  cursor: pointer;\n  padding: 0;\n  line-height: 1;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  letter-spacing: .04em;\n  transition: color var(--transition);\n}\n.toggle-pw:hover { color: var(--rust-light); }\n\n/* Field hint (below input, lighter) */\n.field-hint {\n  font-size: .75rem;\n  color: var(--ink-light);\n  margin-top: .2rem;\n}\n\n/* Password strength bar */\n.pw-strength {\n  margin-top: .4rem;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: .6rem;\n  min-height: 1rem;\n}\n\n.pw-strength-bar {\n  flex: 1;\n  height: 4px;\n  background: var(--cream-dark);\n  border-radius: 2px;\n  overflow: hidden;\n}\n\n.pw-strength-fill {\n  height: 100%;\n  width: 0%;\n  border-radius: 2px;\n  transition: width .3s ease, background .3s ease;\n}\n.pw-strength-fill.s0 { width: 0%;   background: transparent; }\n.pw-strength-fill.s1 { width: 25%;  background: var(--rust); }\n.pw-strength-fill.s2 { width: 50%;  background: var(--gold); }\n.pw-strength-fill.s3 { width: 75%;  background: #7aaf38; }\n.pw-strength-fill.s4 { width: 100%; background: var(--sage); }\n\n.pw-strength-label {\n  font-size: .72rem;\n  color: var(--ink-light);\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  min-width: 48px;\n}\n\n/* Nav user area */\n.nav-user {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: .75rem;\n  margin-left: .25rem;\n  padding-left: 1rem;\n  border-left: 1px solid rgba(245,240,232,.2);\n}\n\n.nav-username {\n  font-size: .82rem;\n  color: rgba(245,240,232,.65);\n  font-style: italic;\n  letter-spacing: .02em;\n}\n\n.btn-logout {\n  background: none;\n  border: 1px solid rgba(245,240,232,.25);\n  color: rgba(245,240,232,.7);\n  font-family: var(--font-body);\n  font-size: .78rem;\n  letter-spacing: .04em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  padding: .3rem .8rem;\n  border-radius: 100px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  transition: all var(--transition);\n}\n.btn-logout:hover {\n  background: rgba(245,240,232,.1);\n  color: var(--cream);\n  border-color: rgba(245,240,232,.5);\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 640px) {\n  .auth-wrap { padding: 1.75rem 1.25rem 1.5rem; }\n  .nav-user  { display: none; } /* username hidden on mobile, logout still in menu */\n}\nEOF"} |

| json_block | {"language": "javascript", "code": "/* auth.js  \u2014  login + signup client-side validation */\n\n(function () {\n\n  // \u2500\u2500 Shared helpers \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n  function fieldEl(id)    { return document.getElementById('field-' + id); }\n  function feedbackEl(id) { return document.getElementById('fb-'    + id); }\n\n  function setValid(id, msg) {\n    var f = fieldEl(id), fb = feedbackEl(id);\n    if (!f) return;\n    f.classList.remove('is-invalid'); f.classList.add('is-valid');\n    if (fb) fb.textContent = msg \|\| '\u2713';\n  }\n\n  function setInvalid(id, msg) {\n    var f = fieldEl(id), fb = feedbackEl(id);\n    if (!f) return;\n    f.classList.remove('is-valid'); f.classList.add('is-invalid');\n    if (fb) fb.textContent = msg;\n  }\n\n  function clearState(id) {\n    var f = fieldEl(id), fb = feedbackEl(id);\n    if (!f) return;\n    f.classList.remove('is-valid', 'is-invalid');\n    if (fb) fb.textContent = '';\n  }\n\n  // Show/hide password toggle (shared by both pages)\n  document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-pw').forEach(function (btn) {\n    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {\n      var target = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.target);\n      if (!target) return;\n      var show = target.type === 'password';\n      target.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';\n      btn.textContent = show ? 'Hide' : 'Show';\n    });\n  });\n\n\n  // \u2500\u2500 LOGIN form \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n  var loginForm = document.getElementById('loginForm');\n  if (loginForm) {\n    var luInput = document.getElementById('username');\n    var lpInput = document.getElementById('password');\n\n    function validateLoginUsername() {\n      var v = luInput.value.trim();\n      if (!v) { setInvalid('username', 'Username is required.'); return false; }\n      setValid('username', '\u2713');\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    function validateLoginPassword() {\n      var v = lpInput.value;\n      if (!v) { setInvalid('password', 'Password is required.'); return false; }\n      setValid('password', '\u2713');\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    luInput.addEventListener('blur',  validateLoginUsername);\n    lpInput.addEventListener('blur',  validateLoginPassword);\n    luInput.addEventListener('input', function () { if (luInput.value.trim()) validateLoginUsername(); else clearState('username'); });\n    lpInput.addEventListener('input', function () { if (lpInput.value)        validateLoginPassword(); else clearState('password'); });\n\n    loginForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {\n      var ok = (validateLoginUsername() & validateLoginPassword());\n      if (!ok) {\n        e.preventDefault();\n        var first = loginForm.querySelector('.is-invalid .field-input');\n        if (first) first.focus();\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n\n  // \u2500\u2500 SIGNUP form \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n  var signupForm = document.getElementById('signupForm');\n  if (signupForm) {\n    var suInput  = document.getElementById('username');\n    var pwInput  = document.getElementById('password');\n    var cfInput  = document.getElementById('confirm');\n    var pwFill   = document.getElementById('pwFill');\n    var pwLabel  = document.getElementById('pwLabel');\n\n    // Username\n    function validateSUUsername() {\n      var v = suInput.value.trim();\n      if (!v)         { setInvalid('username', 'Username is required.');                       return false; }\n      if (v.length < 3) { setInvalid('username', 'Must be at least 3 characters.');            return false; }\n      if (v.length > 50) { setInvalid('username', 'Must be 50 characters or fewer.');          return false; }\n      if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/.test(v)) { setInvalid('username', 'Letters and numbers only.');   return false; }\n      setValid('username', '\u2713 Looks good');\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    // Password strength scoring (0\u20134)\n    function scorePassword(pw) {\n      var score = 0;\n      if (pw.length >= 8)  score++;\n      if (pw.length >= 12) score++;\n      if (/[A-Z]/.test(pw) && /[a-z]/.test(pw)) score++;\n      if (/[0-9]/.test(pw))  score++;\n      if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(pw)) score++;\n      return Math.min(score, 4);\n    }\n\n    var strengthLabels = ['', 'Weak', 'Fair', 'Good', 'Strong'];\n\n    function updateStrength(pw) {\n      if (!pwFill \|\| !pwLabel) return;\n      if (!pw) {\n        pwFill.className = 'pw-strength-fill s0';\n        pwFill.style.width = '0%';\n        pwLabel.textContent = '';\n        return;\n      }\n      var s = scorePassword(pw);\n      pwFill.className = 'pw-strength-fill s' + s;\n      pwLabel.textContent = strengthLabels[s] \|\| '';\n    }\n\n    function validatePassword() {\n      var v = pwInput.value;\n      updateStrength(v);\n      if (!v)         { setInvalid('password', 'Password is required.');           return false; }\n      if (v.length < 8) { setInvalid('password', 'Must be at least 8 characters.'); return false; }\n      setValid('password', '\u2713 Looks good');\n      if (cfInput.value) validateConfirm(); // re-check confirm when password changes\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    function validateConfirm() {\n      var v = cfInput.value;\n      if (!v)                      { setInvalid('confirm', 'Please confirm your password.'); return false; }\n      if (v !== pwInput.value)     { setInvalid('confirm', 'Passwords do not match.');       return false; }\n      setValid('confirm', '\u2713 Passwords match');\n      return true;\n    }\n\n    suInput.addEventListener('input', function () { if (suInput.value.trim()) validateSUUsername(); else clearState('username'); });\n    suInput.addEventListener('blur',  validateSUUsername);\n\n    pwInput.addEventListener('input', function () { updateStrength(pwInput.value); if (pwInput.value) validatePassword(); else clearState('password'); });\n    pwInput.addEventListener('blur',  validatePassword);\n\n    cfInput.addEventListener('input', function () { if (cfInput.value) validateConfirm(); else clearState('confirm'); });\n    cfInput.addEventListener('blur',  validateConfirm);\n\n    signupForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {\n      var ok = (validateSUUsername() & validatePassword() & validateConfirm());\n      if (!ok) {\n        e.preventDefault();\n        var first = signupForm.querySelector('.is-invalid .field-input');\n        if (first) first.focus();\n      } else {\n        var btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');\n        if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Creating account\u2026'; }\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n}());\n", "filename": "/mnt/user-data/outputs/static/js/auth.js"} |

| text | Building everything now — systemd service, Nginx config, and a deploy script you run locally.<br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br>Here's the full picture of what was built and every decision behind it:<br><br>---<br><br>**Architecture change: Gunicorn no longer binds to a port**<br><br>Your current command binds Gunicorn directly to `VM_IP:8010`, which means the internet talks to Gunicorn directly. The new setup uses a **Unix socket** (`/run/bookshelf/bookshelf.sock`) instead. Nginx sits in front, accepts all HTTP traffic on port 80, and passes requests to Gunicorn through that socket. This is faster (no TCP overhead for local traffic), safer (Gunicorn is no longer exposed to the internet), and lets Nginx handle static files, compression, and HTTPS without touching Python at all.<br><br>---<br><br>**`bookshelf.service`** — the systemd unit<br><br>The service runs as a dedicated `bookshelf` system user (not root, not your login user). systemd creates `/run/bookshelf/` automatically at boot via `RuntimeDirectory=`. The `EnvironmentFile=` line reads your `.env` directly, so Gunicorn and Flask see all your secrets without you hardcoding them. `Restart=on-failure` means if the process crashes, systemd brings it back automatically within 5 seconds.<br><br>---<br><br>**`nginx_bookshelf.conf`** — reverse proxy<br><br>Nginx serves everything under `/static/` directly from disk with a 7-day cache header — these never touch Python. Everything else is proxied to Gunicorn. The `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Forwarded-Proto` headers pass the real client IP and whether the original request was HTTP/HTTPS through to Flask.<br><br>---<br><br>**`server_setup.sh`** — one-time VM bootstrap<br><br>Run this once on a fresh VM. It installs all system packages, creates the `bookshelf` system user, clones your repo to `/srv/bookshelf`, builds the virtualenv, installs the systemd service, and links the Nginx config. It prints a checklist at the end of what to do before starting the service.<br><br>---<br><br>**`deploy.sh`** — your local deploy command<br><br>After `git push`, run `./deploy/deploy.sh` from your laptop. It SSHes into the VM, pulls the latest code, re-runs pip (only installs new packages if `requirements.txt` changed), restarts Gunicorn via systemd, and confirms the service came back up. If it doesn't, it prints the last 30 log lines so you can diagnose immediately.<br><br>---<br><br>**The three things to edit before first deploy:**<br><br>```<br>deploy/server_setup.sh  →  REPO_URL="https://github.com/YOU/YOUR_REPO.git"<br>deploy/deploy.sh        →  VM_USER and VM_HOST<br>deploy/nginx_bookshelf.conf  →  server_name YOUR_DOMAIN_OR_IP<br>``` |

| 17 |  |  |  |  | _complex_ |  | null | null | file |  |  | null | null | false |  | null | Presented 6 files | _complex_ | present_files | 2026-06-16T14:15:28.956402Z | 2026-06-16T14:15:28.956408Z | null |  | toolu_01WgvWyf2gt9z2JK6U47SvQJ | tool_result |
| 18 |  |  |  | [] |  |  |  | null |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | 2026-06-16T14:15:30.075280Z | 2026-06-16T14:15:43.709595Z |  | Here's the full picture of what was built and every decision behind it:<br><br>---<br><br>**Architecture change: Gunicorn no longer binds to a port**<br><br>Your current command binds Gunicorn directly to `VM_IP:8010`, which means the internet talks to Gunicorn directly. The new setup uses a **Unix socket** (`/run/bookshelf/bookshelf.sock`) instead. Nginx sits in front, accepts all HTTP traffic on port 80, and passes requests to Gunicorn through that socket. This is faster (no TCP overhead for local traffic), safer (Gunicorn is no longer exposed to the internet), and lets Nginx handle static files, compression, and HTTPS without touching Python at all.<br><br>---<br><br>**`bookshelf.service`** — the systemd unit<br><br>The service runs as a dedicated `bookshelf` system user (not root, not your login user). systemd creates `/run/bookshelf/` automatically at boot via `RuntimeDirectory=`. The `EnvironmentFile=` line reads your `.env` directly, so Gunicorn and Flask see all your secrets without you hardcoding them. `Restart=on-failure` means if the process crashes, systemd brings it back automatically within 5 seconds.<br><br>---<br><br>**`nginx_bookshelf.conf`** — reverse proxy<br><br>Nginx serves everything under `/static/` directly from disk with a 7-day cache header — these never touch Python. Everything else is proxied to Gunicorn. The `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Forwarded-Proto` headers pass the real client IP and whether the original request was HTTP/HTTPS through to Flask.<br><br>---<br><br>**`server_setup.sh`** — one-time VM bootstrap<br><br>Run this once on a fresh VM. It installs all system packages, creates the `bookshelf` system user, clones your repo to `/srv/bookshelf`, builds the virtualenv, installs the systemd service, and links the Nginx config. It prints a checklist at the end of what to do before starting the service.<br><br>---<br><br>**`deploy.sh`** — your local deploy command<br><br>After `git push`, run `./deploy/deploy.sh` from your laptop. It SSHes into the VM, pulls the latest code, re-runs pip (only installs new packages if `requirements.txt` changed), restarts Gunicorn via systemd, and confirms the service came back up. If it doesn't, it prints the last 30 log lines so you can diagnose immediately.<br><br>---<br><br>**The three things to edit before first deploy:**<br><br>```<br>deploy/server_setup.sh  →  REPO_URL="https://github.com/YOU/YOUR_REPO.git"<br>deploy/deploy.sh        →  VM_USER and VM_HOST<br>deploy/nginx_bookshelf.conf  →  server_name YOUR_DOMAIN_OR_IP<br>``` |  | text |

| json_block | {"language": "plaintext", "code": "# /etc/nginx/sites-available/bookshelf\n#\n# Replace YOUR_DOMAIN_OR_IP with your actual domain or VM IP.\n# If you have a domain and want HTTPS, run:\n#   sudo certbot --nginx -d yourdomain.com\n# after this config is in place.\n\nupstream bookshelf_app {\n    # Talk to Gunicorn via the Unix socket (faster than TCP)\n    server unix:/run/bookshelf/bookshelf.sock fail_timeout=0;\n}\n\nserver {\n    listen 80;\n    listen [::]:80;\n    server_name YOUR_DOMAIN_OR_IP;\n\n    # \u2500\u2500 Logging \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    access_log /var/log/nginx/bookshelf_access.log;\n    error_log  /var/log/nginx/bookshelf_error.log;\n\n    # \u2500\u2500 Security headers \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    add_header X-Content-Type-Options  \"nosniff\"       always;\n    add_header X-Frame-Options         \"SAMEORIGIN\"    always;\n    add_header X-XSS-Protection        \"1; mode=block\" always;\n    add_header Referrer-Policy         \"strict-origin-when-cross-origin\" always;\n\n    # \u2500\u2500 Static files served directly by Nginx (bypass Gunicorn) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    location /static/ {\n        alias /srv/bookshelf/static/;\n        expires 7d;\n        add_header Cache-Control \"public, max-age=604800, immutable\";\n        access_log off;\n    }\n\n    # \u2500\u2500 Everything else goes to Gunicorn \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    location / {\n        proxy_pass         http://bookshelf_app;\n        proxy_redirect     off;\n\n        # Pass real client info through to Flask\n        proxy_set_header   Host              $host;\n        proxy_set_header   X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n\n        # Timeouts\n        proxy_connect_timeout 10s;\n        proxy_read_timeout    30s;\n        proxy_send_timeout    30s;\n\n        # Buffer settings (avoids slow-client issues)\n        proxy_buffering    on;\n        proxy_buffer_size  8k;\n        proxy_buffers      8 8k;\n\n        # Max upload size (increase if you add file uploads later)\n        client_max_body_size 2M;\n    }\n}\n", "filename": "/mnt/user-data/outputs/deploy/nginx_bookshelf.conf"} |
| type | json_block |

| json_block | {"language": "bash", "code": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# deploy/server_setup.sh\n#\n# ONE-TIME setup script. Run this once on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VM.\n# After this, use deploy.sh for every subsequent code push.\n#\n# Usage (from your local machine):\n#   ssh user@YOUR_VM_IP \"bash -s\" < deploy/server_setup.sh\n#\n# Or copy it to the VM and run directly:\n#   scp deploy/server_setup.sh user@YOUR_VM_IP:~\n#   ssh user@YOUR_VM_IP\n#   chmod +x server_setup.sh && sudo bash server_setup.sh\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\n# \u2500\u2500 CONFIG \u2014 edit these before running \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nREPO_URL=\"https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO.git\"  # your GitHub repo\nREPO_BRANCH=\"main\"\nAPP_DIR=\"/srv/bookshelf\"\nAPP_USER=\"bookshelf\"\nLOG_DIR=\"/var/log/bookshelf\"\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\necho \"==> [1/8] Updating system packages\"\napt-get update -qq && apt-get upgrade -y -qq\n\necho \"==> [2/8] Installing dependencies\"\napt-get install -y -qq \\\n    python3 python3-pip python3-venv \\\n    postgresql postgresql-contrib \\\n    nginx \\\n    git \\\n    curl\n\necho \"==> [3/8] Creating system user: $APP_USER\"\nif ! id \"$APP_USER\" &>/dev/null; then\n    useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin \"$APP_USER\"\nfi\n\necho \"==> [4/8] Cloning repo to $APP_DIR\"\nif [ -d \"$APP_DIR/.git\" ]; then\n    echo \"    Repo already exists, skipping clone.\"\nelse\n    git clone --branch \"$REPO_BRANCH\" \"$REPO_URL\" \"$APP_DIR\"\nfi\nchown -R \"$APP_USER\":\"$APP_USER\" \"$APP_DIR\"\n\necho \"==> [5/8] Creating Python virtual environment and installing packages\"\npython3 -m venv \"$APP_DIR/venv\"\n\"$APP_DIR/venv/bin/pip\" install --quiet --upgrade pip\n\"$APP_DIR/venv/bin/pip\" install --quiet -r \"$APP_DIR/requirements.txt\"\n\necho \"==> [6/8] Creating log directory\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\nchown \"$APP_USER\":\"$APP_USER\" \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\necho \"==> [7/8] Installing systemd service\"\ncp \"$APP_DIR/deploy/bookshelf.service\" /etc/systemd/system/bookshelf.service\nsystemctl daemon-reload\nsystemctl enable bookshelf\n# (Don't start yet \u2014 .env must be created first)\n\necho \"==> [8/8] Installing Nginx config\"\ncp \"$APP_DIR/deploy/nginx_bookshelf.conf\" /etc/nginx/sites-available/bookshelf\nln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/bookshelf /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/bookshelf\n# Remove the default Nginx site if still enabled\nrm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default\nnginx -t && systemctl reload nginx\n\necho \"\"\necho \"\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\"\necho \"  Setup complete. Before starting the service:\"\necho \"\"\necho \"  1. Create /srv/bookshelf/.env (copy from .env.example)\"\necho \"     and fill in your real DB credentials and SECRET_KEY.\"\necho \"\"\necho \"  2. Set up the database:\"\necho \"     sudo -u postgres psql -c \\\"CREATE USER bookshelf_user WITH PASSWORD 'yourpassword';\\\"\"\necho \"     sudo -u postgres psql -c \\\"CREATE DATABASE bookshelf_db OWNER bookshelf_user;\\\"\"\necho \"     psql -U bookshelf_user -d bookshelf_db -f /srv/bookshelf/schema.sql\"\necho \"\"\necho \"  3. Start the service:\"\necho \"     sudo systemctl start bookshelf\"\necho \"     sudo systemctl status bookshelf\"\necho \"\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\"\n", "filename": "/mnt/user-data/outputs/deploy/server_setup.sh"} |

| json_block | {"language": "bash", "code": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# deploy/deploy.sh\n#\n# Run from your LOCAL machine (inside the repo) after every git push.\n# Pulls latest code on the VM, updates dependencies, and restarts the service.\n#\n# Usage:\n#   chmod +x deploy/deploy.sh       # one-time\n#   ./deploy/deploy.sh              # every deployment\n#\n# Prerequisites on your local machine:\n#   - SSH key already added to the VM (so no password prompt)\n#   - git push already done before running this\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\n# \u2500\u2500 CONFIG \u2014 edit these \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nVM_USER=\"ubuntu\"                # your SSH user on the VM\nVM_HOST=\"YOUR_VM_IP\"            # VM IP or domain\nAPP_DIR=\"/srv/bookshelf\"\nBRANCH=\"main\"\nSERVICE=\"bookshelf\"\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\necho \"==> Deploying branch '$BRANCH' to $VM_USER@$VM_HOST\"\n\nssh \"$VM_USER@$VM_HOST\" bash << REMOTE\nset -euo pipefail\n\necho \"--> Pulling latest code\"\ncd \"$APP_DIR\"\nsudo git fetch origin \"$BRANCH\"\nsudo git reset --hard \"origin/$BRANCH\"\nsudo chown -R \"$SERVICE\":\"$SERVICE\" \"$APP_DIR\"\n\necho \"--> Installing/updating Python dependencies\"\nsudo \"$APP_DIR/venv/bin/pip\" install --quiet --upgrade pip\nsudo \"$APP_DIR/venv/bin/pip\" install --quiet -r \"$APP_DIR/requirements.txt\"\n\necho \"--> Reloading systemd and restarting service\"\nsudo systemctl daemon-reload\nsudo systemctl restart \"$SERVICE\"\n\necho \"--> Checking service health\"\nsleep 2\nsudo systemctl is-active --quiet \"$SERVICE\" \\\n    && echo \"    \u2713 Service is running\" \\\n    \|\| { echo \"    \u2717 Service failed to start \u2014 check logs:\"; sudo journalctl -u \"$SERVICE\" -n 30 --no-pager; exit 1; }\n\necho \"--> Reloading Nginx (picks up any config changes)\"\nsudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx\n\nREMOTE\n\necho \"\"\necho \"\u2713 Deployment complete.\"\necho \"  Logs : ssh $VM_USER@$VM_HOST 'journalctl -u $SERVICE -f'\"\necho \"  App  : http://$VM_HOST\"\n", "filename": "/mnt/user-data/outputs/deploy/deploy.sh"} |
| type | json_block |

| json_block | {"language": "markdown", "code": "# Bookshelf Service \u2014 Deployment Guide\n\nStack: **Ubuntu 24.04 \u2192 Nginx \u2192 Unix socket \u2192 Gunicorn \u2192 Flask \u2192 PostgreSQL**\n\n---\n\n## Directory layout on the VM\n\n```\n/srv/bookshelf/          \u2190 git repo lives here\n    app.py\n    schema.sql\n    requirements.txt\n    .env                 \u2190 secrets (never committed)\n    venv/                \u2190 Python virtualenv\n    static/\n    templates/\n    deploy/\n        bookshelf.service\n        nginx_bookshelf.conf\n        server_setup.sh\n        deploy.sh\n\n/run/bookshelf/\n    bookshelf.sock       \u2190 Gunicorn Unix socket (systemd creates this dir)\n\n/var/log/bookshelf/\n    access.log\n    error.log\n```\n\n---\n\n## Step 1 \u2014 First-time VM setup (run once)\n\nSSH into your VM and run the setup script:\n\n```bash\n# From your local machine\nscp deploy/server_setup.sh ubuntu@YOUR_VM_IP:~\nssh ubuntu@YOUR_VM_IP\nchmod +x server_setup.sh\nsudo bash server_setup.sh\n```\n\nThis installs Python, PostgreSQL, Nginx, clones your repo, creates the\n`bookshelf` system user, installs the systemd service, and links the Nginx config.\n\n---\n\n## Step 2 \u2014 Create the database\n\n```bash\nssh ubuntu@YOUR_VM_IP\n\n# Create DB user and database\nsudo -u postgres psql -c \"CREATE USER bookshelf_user WITH PASSWORD 'your_strong_password';\"\nsudo -u postgres psql -c \"CREATE DATABASE bookshelf_db OWNER bookshelf_user;\"\n\n# Run the schema\npsql -U bookshelf_user -d bookshelf_db -h localhost -f /srv/bookshelf/schema.sql\n```\n\n---\n\n## Step 3 \u2014 Create .env on the VM\n\n```bash\nssh ubuntu@YOUR_VM_IP\nsudo cp /srv/bookshelf/.env.example /srv/bookshelf/.env\nsudo nano /srv/bookshelf/.env\n```\n\nFill in every value:\n\n```\nFLASK_APP=app.py\nFLASK_ENV=production\nSECRET_KEY=<generate with: python3 -c \"import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))\">\nDB_HOST=localhost\nDB_PORT=5432\nDB_NAME=bookshelf_db\nDB_USER=bookshelf_user\nDB_PASSWORD=your_strong_password\n```\n\nLock down the file so only root can read it:\n\n```bash\nsudo chown root:bookshelf /srv/bookshelf/.env\nsudo chmod 640 /srv/bookshelf/.env\n```\n\n---\n\n## Step 4 \u2014 Edit deploy/nginx_bookshelf.conf\n\nReplace `YOUR_DOMAIN_OR_IP` with your actual VM IP or domain name, then commit\nand push, or edit directly on the VM:\n\n```bash\nsudo nano /etc/nginx/sites-available/bookshelf\nsudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx\n```\n\n---\n\n## Step 5 \u2014 Edit deploy/deploy.sh\n\nOpen `deploy/deploy.sh` and set:\n\n```bash\nVM_USER=\"ubuntu\"         # your SSH user\nVM_HOST=\"YOUR_VM_IP\"     # VM IP or domain\n```\n\n---\n\n## Step 6 \u2014 Start the service\n\n```bash\nssh ubuntu@YOUR_VM_IP\nsudo systemctl start bookshelf\nsudo systemctl status bookshelf\n```\n\nYou should see `Active: active (running)`.\n\nVisit `http://YOUR_VM_IP` \u2014 you should see the Bookshelf login page.\n\n---\n\n## Deploying updates (every time)\n\n```bash\n# 1. Make your changes locally\ngit add .\ngit commit -m \"your message\"\ngit push origin main\n\n# 2. Deploy to the VM\n./deploy/deploy.sh\n```\n\nThe script SSHes in, pulls the latest code, updates pip packages if\n`requirements.txt` changed, and restarts Gunicorn. Takes about 5\u201310 seconds.\n\n---\n\n## Useful commands on the VM\n\n```bash\n# Live service logs\njournalctl -u bookshelf -f\n\n# Last 50 log lines\njournalctl -u bookshelf -n 50 --no-pager\n\n# Restart manually\nsudo systemctl restart bookshelf\n\n# Check Nginx\nsudo nginx -t\nsudo systemctl status nginx\n\n# Tail app logs\ntail -f /var/log/bookshelf/access.log\ntail -f /var/log/bookshelf/error.log\n```\n\n---\n\n## Adding HTTPS with Let's Encrypt (optional but recommended)\n\n```bash\nssh ubuntu@YOUR_VM_IP\nsudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx -y\nsudo certbot --nginx -d yourdomain.com\n```\n\nCertbot edits the Nginx config automatically and sets up auto-renewal.\n\n---\n\n## Firewall (ufw)\n\n```bash\nsudo ufw allow OpenSSH\nsudo ufw allow 'Nginx Full'\nsudo ufw enable\nsudo ufw status\n```\n\nPort 8010 does **not** need to be open anymore \u2014 Nginx handles all incoming\ntraffic and proxies internally to the Gunicorn Unix socket.\n", "filename": "/mnt/user-data/outputs/deploy/DEPLOY.md"} |

| text |  The root cause is clear. The `bookshelf` system user has no home directory (`/home/bookshelf` doesn't exist), and Gunicorn's control server tries to write a socket there. The fix is three things in the service file: tell systemd where the home is, stop Gunicorn from touching it, and make sure the socket dir permissions are right.<br><br>Run these commands on your VM right now:<br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br><br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br>Now run these commands on your VM in order — copy-paste the whole block:<br><br>```bash<br># 1. Add www-data to the bookshelf group so Nginx can reach the socket<br>sudo usermod -aG bookshelf www-data<br><br># 2. Copy the fixed service file<br>sudo cp /srv/bookshelf/deploy/bookshelf.service /etc/systemd/system/bookshelf.service<br><br># 3. Reload systemd and restart<br>sudo systemctl daemon-reload<br>sudo systemctl restart bookshelf<br><br># 4. Check it came up clean<br>sudo systemctl status bookshelf<br>```<br><br>Then tail the log to confirm the error is gone:<br>```bash<br>tail -f /var/log/bookshelf/error.log<br>```<br><br>You should only see the four `INFO` startup lines with no `ERROR` after them. Then hit your VM IP in the browser — Nginx should reach the socket and serve the login page.<br><br>---<br><br>**What the three fixes do and why each was needed:**<br><br>`Environment=HOME=/srv/bookshelf` — Gunicorn's control server writes a temporary socket file to `$HOME`. Because the `bookshelf` user was created with `--no-create-home`, `$HOME` defaulted to `/home/bookshelf` which doesn't exist. Pointing it to `/srv/bookshelf` (which does exist and is owned by that user) removes the permission error entirely.<br><br>`--umask 007` — makes Gunicorn create the Unix socket with mode `0660` (`rw-rw----`). Without this the socket can end up as `0600` which only the owner can read, locking Nginx out.<br><br>`RuntimeDirectoryMode=0770` + `usermod -aG bookshelf www-data` — the socket directory itself needs to be traversable by Nginx's `www-data` user. Mode `0770` lets the group in, and adding `www-data` to the `bookshelf` group gives it that group membership. Both are needed — directory permission and group membership together. |

| text | HTTPS without DNS is possible but with real limitations — let me lay out both paths so you can pick.<br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br>Let me check what's already there for these settings before drawing the diagram, then walk you through the two real options.<br>```<br>This block is not supported on your current device yet.<br>```<br><br>Here's the honest breakdown of both routes.<br><br>**Can you do HTTPS with zero DNS, using only the raw IP?** Technically yes, but it comes with a real catch. Let's Encrypt — the free certificate authority almost everyone uses — refuses to issue certificates for bare IP addresses. It only certifies domain names. So without any kind of hostname, your only option is a self-signed certificate you generate yourself. That gives you encryption (traffic is actually scrambled in transit), but every browser will show a "Not secure" or "Your connection is not private" warning on every single visit, because no browser trusts a certificate you signed yourself. This is fine if it's just you testing locally or you don't mind clicking through the warning each time, but it's a poor experience for anyone else accessing the bookshelf.<br><br>**The practical fix that doesn't require buying anything:** free dynamic DNS (DDNS) services give you a real subdomain pointed at your IP, at no cost. That subdomain is enough for Let's Encrypt to issue you a real, trusted certificate — no warnings, proper padlock, works in every browser.<br><br>Good free DDNS options:<br>- **DuckDNS** (duckdns.org) — simplest one, gives you something like `yourname.duckdns.org`, free forever, widely used for exactly this kind of homelab/personal-VM setup<br>- **No-IP** (noip.com) — free tier gives a hostname like `yourname.ddns.net`, requires reconfirming every 30 days to stay active<br>- **Cloudflare** — if you ever do want a real `.com`/`.dev` domain later, Cloudflare's registrar sells at-cost pricing with no markup, and their DNS + proxy layer is excellent<br><br>Since your VM has a static IP (it's a Hetzner VM, so this is almost certainly true), DuckDNS is the cleanest path: you create a free hostname once, point it at your IP, and because the IP doesn't change you basically never touch it again.<br><br>Want me to write the steps for setting up DuckDNS plus the Certbot/Nginx changes to wire in the real certificate? Or would you rather go the self-signed route since this is still early-stage and just for you? |
| updated_at | 2026-06-21T14:34:06.001084Z |
| uuid | 019eea99-d22f-7228-afe5-fb72dbde76a8 |
